description: She wears a floor-length muted navy blue gown with a fitted structured bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold and cream geometric woven borders follow the neckline, shoulder strips, sleeve ends, front and hem. Two circular brooches decorate the upper bodice and a patterned belt has a small round buckle and long fringed end. A cream underdress shows at the lower central opening. A blue-grey woven wrap with modest brown fur-like edging rests along both arms and hangs at the sides. Brown shoes appear below the opaque skirt. No headgear, armor or weapon appears; exact textile and fur materials cannot be verified.
